target.title: fix(ui): reveal message context on timestamp hover
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where assistant message footers permanently showed a separate Context control for secondary usage metadata, making every completed response busier than necessary.

## Why This Change Was Made

The timestamp now owns the existing native disclosure. Fine-pointer hover reveals token, cache, context, cost, and model details in place; click, tap, or keyboard activation keeps the native disclosure open. Messages without usage metadata retain a plain timestamp.

Implementation and review were AI-assisted with Codex under maintainer direction.

## User Impact

Assistant message footers are quieter by default. Context details remain immediately available from the timestamp without a dedicated button, and touch and keyboard users retain click-to-open behavior.

## Evidence

### Before and after

Footer-only screenshots are being attached before merge.

### Verification

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-message.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-responsive.browser.test.ts` — 2 files, 103 tests passed
- Production Control UI Vite build — passed (989 modules)
- Existing-profile Chrome inspection — confirmed the live Context pill behavior and captured a footer-only baseline without message content
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output` — clean; no accepted/actionable findings
